 Thoughtful Yet Budget-Friendly: Xiaomi’s 11.11 Sale Delivers Holiday Tech Gifts for Every Budget
 By Nicole Tesorero - November 13, 2026 0 223 Facebook Twitter Pinterest WhatsApp 
 Spanning smartphones, tablets, wearables, and smart home upgrades, Xiaomi is rolling out practical holiday gift options at special 11.11 prices. 
 Holiday gift shopping does not have to break the bank. With Christmas just around the corner, Xiaomi Philippines is helping shoppers cross names off their lists early through its 11.11 campaign, highlighting markdowns across smartphones, tablets, wearables, home appliances, and daily tech essentials. 
 Whether you are picking out a handset upgrade for a family member, a fitness wearable for someone getting active, or a smart home gadget for the entire household, Xiaomi’s 11.11 lineup pairs everyday usefulness with accessible pricing. Featuring deals across Xiaomi, REDMI, and POCO products, the sale gives early holiday buyers plenty of ways to save while shopping smart. 
 For the Ones Who Are Always Connected 
 A reliable smartphone is a surefire hit for anyone who depends on their phone for work, streaming, and keeping in touch with family and friends. For 11.11, Xiaomi is spotlighting choices tailored to different lifestyles and budgets: 
 • REDMI 17 (4GB+128GB): Built for everyday dependability, this model packs a massive 7,500mAh battery, an expansive 6.9-inch screen, and a 50MP AI dual camera setup. Marked down from ₱12,999, it drops to a promo price of ₱11,999. 
 • REDMI Note 17 Pro 5G (6GB+256GB): Ideal for users who want elevated specs and rugged reliability, this variant showcases the lineup’s signature Titan Durability features. Originally retailing at ₱24,999, it is offered at ₱22,999. 
 POCO also rounded out Xiaomi’s 11.11 showcase with handsets tailored to every kind of mobile user:
 • POCO C95 Pro: Offered at ₱10,999 for the 6GB+128GB model and ₱12,999 for the 8GB+256GB version, delivering budget-friendly reliability for daily tasks.
 • POCO X6 & POCO X8s: For buyers willing to stretch their budget slightly further, the POCO X6 started at ₱21,999 while the POCO X8s started at ₱22,999.
 • POCO F8 Ultra: Those eyeing a flagship-level holiday gift can look toward the POCO F8 Ultra, highlighted at ₱41,999 (12GB+256GB) and ₱44,999 (16GB+512GB).
 For the Students, Creatives, and Everyday Multitaskers 
 For family members and friends who love studying, creating, streaming, or working on the go, a tablet makes an adaptable everyday companion:
 • Xiaomi Pad 7 (8GB+128GB): Built for portability, coursework, entertainment, and multitasking, this tablet dropped from ₱25,999 to ₱18,999 during the 11.11 promo.
 • Xiaomi Pad 8 (8GB+128GB): Highlighted at ₱21,999 (down from ₱26,499), giving users another spacious, convenient screen for daily productivity and media.
 For the Fitness Enthusiasts and Music Lovers 
 Some of the most appreciated gifts blend seamlessly into daily habits. For loved ones who enjoy working out, listening to playlists, or tracking their wellness goals, Xiaomi’s Lazada Bundle Deals paired wearables and audio gear at discounted rates—complete with a complimentary Xiaomi Mi Casual Daypack:
 • Xiaomi Smart Band 9 Active + REDMI Buds 6 Active Bundle: Marked down to ₱1,999 (from ₱2,528), uniting everyday fitness tracking with wireless earbuds.
 • REDMI Watch 5 + REDMI Buds 6 Active Bundle: Priced at ₱5,299 (down from ₱6,328) for shoppers looking to gift a full smartwatch experience alongside wireless audio.
 For the Homebodies and Practical Gift-Givers 
 Not every great Christmas present has to fit in a pocket. For recipients who love spending cozy time indoors, Xiaomi’s Shopee-exclusive 11.11 home lineup spotlighted practical upgrades for the entire household:
 • Xiaomi TV A 55 2026: Slashed from ₱22,690 to ₱19,999, ideal for upgrading family movie nights and living room entertainment.
 • Mijia Front Load Washer 9kg: Highlighted at ₱19,999 (down from ₱20,999) to help lighten everyday laundry chores.
 • Mijia Smart Air Purifiers: Shoppers looking to invest in cleaner indoor air can also consider the Mijia Smart Air Purifier 6 Plus (featured at ₱18,999) or the Mijia Smart Air Purifier 6 EU (featured at ₱11,499).
 For Those Looking to Make Their Homes Smarter 
 If you want to gift something beyond standard personal gadgets, Xiaomi’s Lazada-exclusive AIoT bundles brought together connected air-care and home-security devices—with every package including a bonus Xiaomi Mi Casual Daypack:
 • Air Care Bundle 1: Combined the Xiaomi Smart Air Purifier 4 Compact and Xiaomi Humidifier 2 Lite for ₱5,299 (down from ₱6,948).
 • Air Care Bundle 2: Paired the Xiaomi Smart Air Purifier 4 Lite with the Xiaomi Smart Humidifier 2 for ₱9,998 (down from ₱11,048).
 • Security Bundle 1: Bundled the Xiaomi Smart Camera C100 and Outdoor Camera CW100 Dual for ₱3,578 (down from ₱4,848).
 • Security Bundle 2: Brought together the Xiaomi Smart Camera C301 and Outdoor Camera CW300 for ₱4,298 (down from ₱6,148).
 • Stocking Stuffer Pick: For compact, practical gifts, Xiaomi also spotlighted a Shopee-exclusive pair of 10,000mAh Power Banks for ₱1,999—handy for friends and relatives always on the move.
 Smart Tech Picks for Your Christmas Shopping List 
 Spanning budget-friendly accessories and wearables to smartphones, tablets, and connected home appliances, Xiaomi Philippines’ 11.11 gift guide showcases plenty of thoughtful options for everyone on your holiday list. By pairing everyday utility with accessible price points, Xiaomi makes it simple to pick out tech gifts built to be enjoyed well beyond the Christmas season.
 Shoppers can check out these devices and ongoing holiday offers via Xiaomi’s participating official online storefronts on Shopee and Lazada, with prices, stock availability, and bundle inclusions subject to applicable terms and conditions.
